# Resources Lease Contract Street/Community Columns Lack Formatter
resourcesLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue property-area dialog returns subdistrict/community as division codes; table columns not configured with formatter.

## Problem
- In resourcesLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue property-area select dialog, street (街道) and community (社区) columns bind to subdistrict/community code fields.
- The codes are not converted to Chinese names, showing raw codes in the table.

## Fix
- Add subdistrictFormatter and communityFormatter to the street and community columns.
- Reuse mapping logic from area.js mixin introduced via detailMixins.

## Verification and Attribution
- Files: src/views/benefit/resourcesLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue, src/views/benefit/assetsLeaseContractFiling/index.vue, src/views/benefit/assetsLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue, src/mixins/area.js, src/mixins/detailMixins.js, src/components/zs-select-dialog/zs-select-dialog-func.vue, src/components/zs-select-dialog/zs-select-dialog.vue, src/views/benefit/resourcesLeaseContractFiling/index.vue.
- Project: 园区公共收益; source session: 6bb1b34b-eb24-4b0a-b69b-69e34156d925; code baseline: none.

# zs-operate-column Disabled Still Triggers Delete
zs-operate-column.vue disabled state still fires @click.native, and houseTable.vue handleDelete lacked canOperate check, causing deletes on disabled rows.

## Problem
- zs-operate-column.vue: when disabled, @click.native still triggered the delete handler.
- houseTable.vue handleDelete did not check canOperate before deleting.
- bizState defaulted to 0, misjudged as pending submission (待提交).

## Fix
- Component added isButtonDisabled/onButtonClick so disabled buttons do not execute delete.
- houseTable.vue removed visible grey-out display.
- handleDelete starts with a canOperate check.
- bizState default value changed to undefined.

## Verification and Attribution
- Files: src/views/benefit/assetsLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue, src/views/benefit/assetLeaseApply/components/houseTable.vue, src/mixins/subTableMixins.js, src/components/zs-operate-column/zs-operate-column.vue, src/mixins/table.js, src/views/benefit/assetLeaseApply/components/subAdvertiseTable.vue, src/mixins/leaseContractMixins.js, src/mixins/detailMixins.js.
- Project: 园区公共收益; source session: 4901c51b-48fd-4552-a991-5fc17b4c1409; code baseline: none.

# Filed Committee Member View Dialog Missing Appointment End Date
Filed property-management-committee detail (sourceType=='1') member info via CandidateDialog.vue only bound appointmentStartDate in view mode.

## Problem
- In autonomy/record detail (sourceType=='1'), committee member info uses CandidateDialog.vue.
- View mode only bound appointmentStartDate, omitting appointmentEndDate.

## Fix
- View mode display value changed to `${appointmentStartDate} - ${appointmentEndDate}` to show the full appointment range.

## Verification and Attribution
- Files: src/views/autonomy/record/components/MemberInformationDialog.vue, src/views/autonomy/record/components/directDetail.vue, src/views/autonomy/record/components/MemberInformationTable.vue, src/views/autonomy/record/components/CandidateDialog.vue, src/views/autonomy/record/components/enums.js.
- Project: 园区公共收益; source session: 58932c77-9976-4438-bd4c-10b468124d4c; code baseline: none.

- Building auth detail table (complexBuildingAuth/detail.vue, BuildingDialogAuth.vue) should wrap dialog-right to reuse the global dialog style (index.scss).
- Remove custom row-height/font-size/border overrides; selected row uses zs-table built-in selected-row.
- Fixed height of 8 rows (tableTrCount) with 48px row height; only keep the transfer-layout styles.
- Source session: 2f2222a6-6625-4a0d-b9a5-d2cce60498f7.
